name: Pickled Ginger
siboNotes: Fresh ginger is naturally low FODMAP and well-tolerated. The pickling process may enhance digestibility and provide gut-soothing properties.
preparationTips: Rinse briefly if very salty or if you're sodium-sensitive
Use as a palate cleanser between different foods
Add to stir-fries or salads for a tangy kick
Store opened jars in refrigerator for up to 2 months
nutritionalHighlights: Contains gingerol compounds with anti-inflammatory properties
Source of beneficial probiotics from fermentation
